label: thm:q-ns-wellposedness
title: Global regularity of the $q$-deformed Navier--Stokes equation
html:
Theorem. Global regularity of the q-deformed Navier--Stokes equation

Let (\mathbf{C}, A, \tau) describe a QOU governed by substrate parameter q \in \mathrm{End}(\mathbf{1}), with q > 1. Let \Delta_q = d_q\delta_q + \delta_q d_q act as the q-Laplacian on \Omega^k(A), and set the kinematic viscosity \nu_q = \frac{1}{2}(1 - q^{-1}) > 0.

Categorical statement. Let v_0 \in \ker(\delta_q|_{\Omega^1(A)}) be a divergence-free initial velocity 1-form carrying finite Frobenius norm \lVert v_0 \rVert_A^2 = \int_A v_0^\dagger \wedge v_0 < \infty. The q-deformed Navier--Stokes system then admits a unique global solution

  (v, p) \colon [0, \infty)
   \to 
  \ker(\delta_q|_{\Omega^1(A)}) \times A

satisfying:

  1. Smoothness in \mathbf{C}: The map t \mapsto v(t) \in \Omega^1(A) is smooth (infinitely differentiable within the internal hom of \mathbf{C}).

  2. Energy inequality: For all t \geq 0,

      \lVert v(t) \rVert_A^2
  + 2\nu_q \int_0^t
  \lVert d_qv(s) \rVert_A^2ds
   \leq 
  \lVert v_0 \rVert_A^2.

  3. Spectral decay: The \Delta_q-eigencomponents \hat{v}_k \in V_k \subset \Omega^1(A) (where \Delta_q|_{V_k} = [k]_q^2\mathrm{id}) satisfy

      |\hat{v}_k(t)|  \leq 
  |\hat{v}_k(0)|e^{-\nu_q [k]_q^2 t}.

    Modes decay at a rate exponential in k.

Archimedean realisation. Operating under the fibre functor \tau, the categorical solution maps directly to a smooth vector field on the state bundle \mathcal{S}:

  \tau(v) \in C^\infty(\mathcal{S} \times [0,\infty); T\mathcal{S}),
  \qquad
  \nabla_A \cdot \tau(v) = 0,

satisfying the coordinate equation

  \partial_t v + (v \cdot \nabla_A) v
  = 
  -\frac{1}{\rho}\nabla_A p
  - \nabla_A Q_q
  + \nu_q\Delta_q v,
  \qquad
  v|_{t=0} = v_0,

and bound by the continuous energy inequality

  \lVert v(\cdot, t)\rVert_{L^2}^2
  + 2\nu_q \int_0^t
  \sum_{k=1}^\infty [k]_q^2|\hat{v}_k(s)|^2ds
   \leq 
  \lVert v_0\rVert_{L^2}^2

for all t \geq 0.
